title: DupeCustom
body:
UltimateDupe | Advanced Permission-Based Duplication
UltimateDupe is a streamlined, lightweight, and highly configurable duplication plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers. Whether you’re running an Anarchy, Creative, or specialized Economy server, this plugin gives you full control over who can duplicate what, and how often.

With native LuckPerms integration, you can transform a simple "dupe" command into a powerful donor perk or a progression-based reward.

🚀 Key Features
Smart Duplication: Easily duplicate the item in your main hand with a simple command.

LuckPerms Integration: Define custom limits and access levels based on player ranks.

Item Blacklist: Prevent players from duplicating sensitive items (e.g., Bedrock, Barrier blocks, or custom Shulker boxes).

Cooldown System: Avoid server-side lag and economy inflation by setting global or rank-specific cooldowns.

Amount Control: Limit the number of items a player can receive per command (e.g., VIPs get a full stack, default players get only 1).

NBT Support: Perfectly preserves enchantments, custom names, lore, and internal data.

🛠️ LuckPerms & Permissions
This plugin is built to work seamlessly with your existing permission setup. You can create tiered duplication access:

ultimatedupe.use: Basic access to the /dupe command.

ultimatedupe.admin: Access to reload the config and bypass blacklists.

ultimatedupe.cooldown.<seconds>: Set custom cooldowns via permission nodes.

ultimatedupe.limit.<amount>: Control the maximum stack size allowed per dupe.

📋 Commands
/dupe - Duplicates the item held in your hand.

/dupe reload - Reloads the configuration file (Admin only).
